claims: Perform sedation interruption and titrate sedation to target RASS 0, reassessing Richmond-RAS Scale.
Wean ventilator support with spontaneous breathing trial assessment, given PSV 10 and spontaneous respiratory rate 19, to evaluate extubation readiness.
Titrate inspired oxygen to maintain SpO2 92-96%, given FiO2 50% and PaO2 81 mmHg.
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring via arterial line and central venous pressure.
Continue continuous cardiac monitoring and temporary pacemaker surveillance with backup rate 45 bpm.
Recheck blood glucose and continue insulin infusion titration per protocol, given fingerstick glucose 134 mg/dL.
Follow up serum potassium given whole blood potassium 5.5 mEq/L and active potassium chloride orders.
Reassess pain and titrate analgesia, given pain level 6 and active opioid orders.
Perform delirium screening with CAM-ICU, given positive MS change and RASS -1.
Mobilize patient out of bed with PT/OT, given JH-HLM 4 and bedfast Braden activity.
